invariants.statement: The clone makes no runtime request to beanbox.com or any external origin.
acceptance_obligations: Runtime network audit reports zero remote requests.

invariants.statement: Checkout accepts only documented synthetic local fixtures and never collects or transmits real payment credentials.
acceptance_obligations: Approved, declined and retryable local-sandbox scenarios have server-side tests.

invariants.statement: Preparation, taste, quantity, cadence and plan choices persist through review and local checkout.
acceptance_obligations: Browser journey and backend tests bind all selections to the local checkout.

invariants.statement: At least 200 deterministic coffee records are searchable, filterable, pageable and openable as details.
acceptance_obligations: Catalogue data test counts at least 200 records and opens every detail route.

invariants.statement: Cart and checkout state are isolated by local session and fail closed across actors.
acceptance_obligations: A second actor cannot read or mutate the first actor's cart or checkout.

invariants.statement: Reset and restart restore the documented deterministic seed and state semantics.
acceptance_obligations: Reset, restart and duplicate submission probes are deterministic.
